key_terms: Arrow's in-process ABI for passing arrays between languages through C structures. A release callback tells the producer when the consumer no longer needs the buffers.
Exchanging Arrow data as IPC bytes between independent implementations, here Python Arrow 23 and Rust Arrow 60, which must agree on the schema and data.
An RPC framework over gRPC that streams Arrow record batches between a client and a server, with descriptors naming datasets and tickets authorizing one retrieval.
An opaque token returned by get_flight_info that the client presents to do_get to stream the data. The workshop server rejects every ticket it did not issue.
evidence: Actual owned Docker workshop observations, with source, failure and lifecycle scope stated separately. Commands are not executed by the classroom pad.
